confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge, not live listings or web-sourced prices. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately well known. Room rates vary widely by property and season, and July is green season, so accommodation anchors lean toward lower-season levels. Cocktail and wine_glass are the weakest anchors: direct knowledge is limited, so both were set from the beer anchor at roughly 3 to 4 times beer.
comparable_city_reasoning: Southeast Asian heritage and backpacker-hub basis, benchmarked against comparable regional tourist towns such as Luang Prabang, Hoi An and Chiang Mai, with Phnom Penh as a Cambodian cross-check and adjusted for Angkor-driven tourism demand in Siem Reap.
